title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: MOFs can be used either directly as electrocatalysts with engineered nodes or linkers, or as precursors that yield metal nanoparticles or single-atom sites in a potentially conductive carbonaceous matrix.
explanation: Controlled decomposition clusters the metal component or creates isolated metal sites while transforming the organic component.
conditions: The precursor route requires controlled transformation of the framework.
caveats: The resulting carbon matrix is described as potentially, not necessarily, conductive.
